title: Run packaged desktop/mobile E2E and preservation gates
acceptance_criteria: Run packaged same-origin desktop/mobile Playwright with real PostgreSQL/private S3 and separate A/B owner and customer contexts plus admin: onboard/publish distinct setups, submit with image and consent, retry, persist through restart, rename/retire, expire/reactivate and check offline/error feedback.

Show scoped list/detail/update/receipt/media denial, preview isolation, and no demo writes. Run frontend test/build and legacy showcase/booking/marketing tests at documented origins without overwriting reports.
Compare routes, alias/history/WebGL, all iframe stages, visuals and inventories to 01; log the exact pre-existing mismatch separately and block on any new drift, failure or missing dependency.
deliverables: Scrubbed E2E output and screenshots, legacy results, migration/storage assertions and preservation comparison
